name: FlutLink
subtitle: TEST — iOS port created by opencode. FlutCloud client for iOS.
description:
TEST — FlutLink iOS is a test port created entirely by opencode. It is not a production build.

FlutLink is a dedicated client for the FlutCloud server. It connects exclusively to the FlutCloud server and rejects servers that do not run the FlutCloud Nextcloud app.
